name: Chedorlaomer
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The five kings served Chedorlaomer twelve years and rebelled in the thirteenth; the four kings defeated them and took the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah.

note.label: Genesis 14: The War of the Kings and Melchizedek
